name: agent-bridge
description: Local MCP bridge for controlled, auditable collaboration between coding agents.
long_description: Coordinate Codex, Claude, Gemini, and optional Manus tasks through one local MCP server. Agent Bridge enforces project roots, sandbox ceilings, explicit remote-egress consent, bounded transcripts, cancellation, and durable handoffs.

allowed_root.title: Creator project folder
allowed_root.description: Choose one project folder that delegated agents may access. Add more roots later in the advanced JSON configuration.

enable_codex.title: Enable Codex CLI
enable_codex.description: Requires an installed and signed-in Codex CLI.

enable_claude.title: Enable Claude Code CLI
enable_claude.description: Requires an installed and signed-in Claude Code CLI.

enable_gemini.title: Enable Gemini CLI
enable_gemini.description: Optional; disabled by default because read-only enforcement is limited.

enable_manus.title: Enable Manus API
enable_manus.description: Optional remote backend. Remote egress remains disabled until advanced policy is configured.

manus_credential_file.title: Manus credential file
manus_credential_file.description: Optional path to a user-only file containing the Manus API key. Never put the key in this manifest.

manus_acknowledge_account_default_capabi.title: Acknowledge Manus account defaults
manus_acknowledge_account_default_capabi.description: Enable only after reviewing the Manus account's default skills. This does not disable those provider-side capabilities.

manus_account_capability_profile.title: Reviewed Manus capability profile
manus_account_capability_profile.description: Stable 1-128 character label for the reviewed Manus account/default-skill set, for example reviewed-2026-08-19.
